overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by holding an inaudible concurrent meeting during a Finance Committee hearing and by failing to list an anticipated warrant-review topic on its notice; no intent found, compliance and training ordered.

allegations.summary: Board held its own discussion and recommendations on warrant articles at a table during a Finance Committee hearing, in hushed voices, so the public could not hear it.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Board's meeting was entirely inaudible to the public, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Board discussed warrant article recommendations at the joint meeting, a topic not listed on its notice, which only said it would view the Finance Committee presentation.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by proceeding with a discussion of this anticipated topic.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
Board members review AG Open Meeting Law Training Videos #1 (Introduction and Open Meeting Law definitions) and #2 (Notice) and certify compliance to the AG within 30 days of the letter.
